_note: Provenance registry for REAL AUTHORITATIVE DOCUMENTS. Canonical entries are distinct by content and policy purpose. Mirror URLs never count as additional sources. Scenario data and generated constraints remain simulated/model-generated and are not part of this corpus.

documents.publisher: National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA), Government of India
documents.title: National Disaster Management Guidelines: Management of Floods
documents.access_note: Publicly accessible official NDMA PDF; an NIDM URL serves the byte-identical file.
documents.notes: Retained as the primary India-specific flood-management source. The signed foreword date is authoritative; embedded PDF creation metadata is unreliable.

spot_checks.relevance: Calls for flood shelters and flood-safe relief centres on high ground with resilient communications.
Assigns evacuation, rescue, and relief responsibilities during severe flooding.
Addresses medical evacuation equipment, staffing, triage, and patient movement.

documents.publisher: National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA), Government of India
documents.title: National Disaster Management Plan 2019
documents.access_note: Publicly accessible official NDMA PDF linked from the Ministry of Home Affairs NDM India policy portal.
documents.notes: Retained as the cross-hazard national planning framework. Some extracted ligatures contain NUL characters, but 379 of 384 pages have substantial readable text.

spot_checks.relevance: Requires inclusive early warning, evacuation, relief, and rehabilitation practices.
Discusses evacuation difficulty, local support networks, and lists of people needing additional assistance.
Calls for shelters, support facilities, and multiple reliable access and escape routes.
Requires identification and display of evacuation routes and temporary refuge areas.
Covers relief camps, temporary shelters, supplier arrangements, and regional logistics.

documents.publisher: National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA), Government of India
documents.title: National Guidelines for Temporary Shelters
documents.access_note: Publicly accessible NDMA publication hosted by NIDM, Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India.
documents.notes: Retained for operational shelter siting, services, inclusive design, and supply logistics. Ninety-four of 100 pages have extractable text.

spot_checks.relevance: Covers site selection, planning, design, materials, gender, vulnerability, and disability.
Specifies hygienic water and sanitation planning for temporary shelter sites.
Requires facilities and provisions for persons with disabilities in emergency and intermediate shelters.
Calls for regional logistics facilities and coordinated stocks of shelters, tents, and non-food items.
